name: clawd-doom
description: Play DOOM inside Claude Code: /doom opens a pane and runs the game in your terminal, drawn in half-block pixels.

wad.title: Your own WAD file (optional)
wad.description: Full path to a DOOM.WAD, DOOM1.WAD (shareware), DOOM2.WAD or any IWAD you own. Leave empty to play Freedoom, which ships with the plugin.
